_comment: Reviewed attribute-synonym merges for the open-set all-pairs scan, applied AFTER last-token canonicalization. Built by reviewing the frequency table of the 2020 last-token attributes in the full COCO proposals (73399 captions); only clear synonyms with the same question semantics are merged - near-misses (expression vs emotion, location vs setting, dress/uniform vs attire) are deliberately left split. A documented default, not a fixed truth.
